name: docs-ai-island
description: A polished, framework-neutral AI handoff island for documentation sites.
author: Sohab Sk

scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm build:js && pnpm build:css
scripts.clean: rimraf dist playground/dist fixtures/html/dist fixtures/vitepress/.vitepress/dist fixtures/vitepress/.vitepress/cache coverage playwright-report test-results .tmp/html-packed .tmp/vitepress-packed
scripts.test:fixture:html: pnpm build && pnpm --dir fixtures/html typecheck && pnpm --dir fixtures/html build && playwright test --config fixtures/html/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:fixture:html:pack: pnpm build && rimraf .package .tmp/html-packed && pnpm pack --pack-destination .package && node scripts/test-html-package.mjs
scripts.test:fixture:vitepress: pnpm build && pnpm --dir fixtures/vitepress typecheck && pnpm --dir fixtures/vitepress build && playwright test --config fixtures/vitepress/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:fixture:vitepress:pack: pnpm build && rimraf .package .tmp/vitepress-packed && pnpm pack --pack-destination .package && node scripts/test-vitepress-package.mjs
scripts.test:package: pnpm build && publint --pack false --strict && rimraf .package && pnpm pack --pack-destination .package && attw .package/*.tgz --profile esm-only --entrypoints . && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm docs:customization:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:types && pnpm test:package && pnpm test:size
